title: 第17章 哈利尔森要请客！第18章 传说中的英雄救美？
content_zh:
第017章 哈利尔森要请客！
下午，青年队的日常训练过后，托马斯便拉着王利来到了球场中。
每天这个时候，俱乐部的工作人员、教练员们都下班回家了，而各个一线队的主力队员们以及很多青年队的球员也回到了自己的住所，只有少数几个居住在球员宿舍的青年队队员还呆在俱乐部中。
两人一起把球场上的皮球摆成了一整排，而后，托马斯便回到了门前，准备开始他的守门练习。
在平时训练过程中，王利很少做射门练习，在青年队中，他是一个右边锋，长传、盘带以及带球速度的优势能让他在这个位置上做的很好，而对他来说，当前最最重要的当然是跑位、短传配合的训练。
王利自己也并不知晓他的任意球水平如何，他接触足球的时间毕竟还很短暂。
他用脚尖轻轻在皮球上点了点，向球门方向看去。这个位置在球门右角六十度左右，距离球门有二十几米，托马斯正站在这个角度的正中，身体半蹲的认真的盯着他脚下的足球。
王利向后退了几步，然后猛然的快速摆动双腿，右脚大力的踢在皮球上，‘碰’的一声，足球就向着球门的左角径直飞了过去。
托马斯一直认真的看着皮球，但是王利这角球力量实在太大了，而且在射门的瞬间右脚还灌输了一丝内力，力量绝不可小视，只见球门前的托马斯虽然已经极力的想要挑起扑球，但显然他的身体根本不可能反应过来，球便径直进入了球网，带球一片浪花。
“再来！”托马斯有些不服气的道。
看着他的样子，王利笑了笑，并没有说什么。球摆放的位置有些太过靠近球门了，而且自己用内力踢出的球速度实在太快，他反应不过来也很正常。
他缓缓走到第二个球旁边，后退了两步，跑动......摆腿......右脚狠力的抽在了皮球上，这次足球是向球门左角飞去，他可不会脚下留情，既然托马斯想要练习守门能力，他就会发挥自己的实力，这样才能达到锻炼的效果。
托马斯猛然跳起，但却还是有些慢了，球擦着他的双手手指边缘飞了进去。
“再来！”托马斯堵气的继续道，自己虽然只是青年队的替补守门员，但是这种二十几米外的远射不可能一个也扑不出来。
看了看托马斯，王利也只能继续...
......
二十分钟以后，王利气喘吁吁的坐在草地上，他确实有些累了，今天的运动量实在太大了，需要好好休息一下。托马斯径直走到他的身旁，满脸无奈的对他抱怨着。
“你的大力射门也太变态了吧，怎么能有那么快的速度，我看就算是一线队的主力前锋也不可能一直踢出这种球啊，我看你下次只要一直站在对方大禁区附近，拿到球就射门，就算替不进去球，也能踢下去人了...”他都有些感到无力了。
就在刚刚短短的二十分钟，面前这个身材有些瘦弱的黑发小子，连续踢了几十脚球，中途也只是失误了死次而已，这其中，进入门框的球他只扑出了两个。而且，球的力量也实在太大了，他面对这种球时都怀疑自己的双手会不会直接断掉…
听了托马斯的抱怨声后，王利点了点头，道：“不要灰心，我踢出的球力量有些大，什么时候你能守住这种球，你就不比一线队的守门员差了。”

托马斯有些吃惊长大嘴巴，随后满脸喜悦的道：“真的吗？那咱们就继续吧！”
托马斯对王利有一种发自内心的信任，自从认识王利之后，他就觉得这个黑发的男孩全身透露出很强的神秘性，奇怪的睡觉方式，中国功夫，充满艺术性的带球身姿，都让他感到一种古老的神秘，他不明白这到底是为什么，但不妨碍他对这种神秘的信任。
听到托马斯想要继续之后，王利顿时满身冷汗，赶忙说道：“还是算了吧，我已经快要累死了，今天就先到这里吧。”
托马斯还有些意犹未尽，不过他也知道，王利最近中午都要做体能锻炼，显然不可能有这么多的体力继续陪他练习了。
他双臂摆在两侧，身体垂直的跳了跳，道：“好吧，那咱们就回去吧，明天可要继续陪我练习啊，我的梦想是成为英格兰的国门呢，到时候钱会有的，老婆也会有的，少妇更是会有的，嘿嘿…嘿嘿！”
看着脸上带着纯真表情，嘴里却说出这种话的托马斯，王利觉得帮助他是不是一种错误啊...
......
两人回到宿舍之后，冲个澡后，托马斯便打算拉着王利一起去吃晚饭。
平时，在中午的时候，他们都是吃俱乐部提供的营养餐，而晚饭就必须自己去解决了，最近几天晚上，王利都是的俱乐部旁边的一家快餐店解决的。
两人穿好衣服，略微收拾下东西，就准备出门了。
这个时候，王利的手机却响了，他从裤兜里掏出手机，看了看上面的显示，是哈利尔森.克拉克。
‘真是奇怪，哈利尔森这个时候打电话给我做什么？’他有些疑惑，便按下了接听键。
“嗨，艾伦，我是哈利尔森，你在哪？”
“我在宿舍里，正打算和托马斯一起去用餐呢。”
“那就太好了，艾伦，快来俱乐部西面这家chipstix，我请客，皮特也在这儿，饭后就一起去森林酒吧，对了，顺便叫上托马斯。”哈利尔森一口气说道。
王利楞了楞，这才想起和曼联队比赛之前，哈利尔森是有说过如果他能进球，就请他去酒吧随便点的，他‘嗯’了一声，笑着对着电话说道：“好的，我马上来。”
对王利来说，有人请吃饭，这种好事儿，他当然不会错过。
修习内家功法需要大量食物来提供营养，武林中常说的‘大口吃肉，大口喝酒’便是这个道理，而青年队的薪水也只够他的饭钱而已，所以他现在最喜欢的就是别人请客了。
而且自从来到伍尔弗汉普顿后，他就一直在训练，还没有出去玩过，今天的训练已经足够了，出去玩玩也不错。
content_en:
Chapter 017 Harilson wants a treat!
In the afternoon, after the daily training of the youth team, Thomas dragged Wang Li to the court.
At this time every day, the club's staff and coaches have all gone home from get off work, and the main players of each first team and many youth team players have also returned to their residences. Only a few youth team players who live in the players' dormitories still stay in the club.
The two of them arranged the balls on the court in a row, and then Thomas returned to the goal, ready to start his goalkeeping practice.
In normal training, Wang Li rarely does shooting exercises. In the youth team, he is a right winger. His advantages in long passing, dribbling and ball speed allow him to do well in this position. For him, the most important thing at the moment is of course the training of running positions and short passing.
Wang Li himself doesn't know what his free kick level is. After all, his time in contact with football is still very short.
He tapped the ball lightly with his toes and looked towards the goal. This position is about 60 degrees to the right corner of the goal, more than 20 meters away from the goal. Thomas is standing in the middle of this angle, half-crouched, staring at the football at his feet seriously.
Wang Li took a few steps back, then swung his legs suddenly and quickly, and kicked the ball hard with his right foot. With a 'bump', the football flew straight towards the left corner of the goal.
Thomas had been watching the ball carefully, but Wang Li's corner kick was too powerful, and at the moment of shooting, his right foot also imbued a little internal force. Strength must not be underestimated. Although Thomas in front of the goal tried his best to provoke the ball, it was obvious that his body could not react at all, and the ball went straight into the net, making a splash with the ball.
"Come again!" Thomas said a little unconvinced.
Looking at his appearance, Wang Li smiled and said nothing. The ball was placed a little too close to the goal, and the ball he kicked out with his own internal force was too fast, so it was normal that he couldn't react.
He slowly walked to the second ball, took two steps back, ran...swinged his legs...and hit the ball hard with his right foot. This time the ball flew towards the left corner of the goal. He would not be merciful. Since Thomas wanted to practice his goalkeeping ability, he would use his strength to achieve the training effect.
Thomas jumped up suddenly, but was still a little slow, and the ball flew in while grazing the edges of his fingers.
"Come again!" Thomas continued angrily. Although he was only the substitute goalkeeper of the youth team, it was impossible that he could not save all the long shots from more than 20 meters away.
After looking at Thomas, Wang Li could only continue...
...
Twenty minutes later, Wang Li sat on the grass panting. He was indeed a little tired. The amount of exercise today was too great and he needed a good rest. Thomas walked directly to him and complained to him helplessly.
"Your powerful shot is too abnormal. How can it be so fast? I don't think even the main forward of the first team can kick such a ball all the time. I think next time you just need to stand near the opponent's penalty area and shoot when you get the ball. Even if you can't score the goal, you can still kick it..." He felt a little powerless.
In just twenty minutes, the thin black-haired boy in front of him kicked dozens of balls in a row and only made a few mistakes in the process. Among them, he only saved two balls that entered the goal frame. Moreover, the power of the ball was so great that he doubted whether his hands would be broken directly when facing such a ball...
After hearing Thomas's complaints, Wang Li nodded and said: "Don't be discouraged, the ball I kicked is a bit powerful. Whenever you can defend this kind of ball, you will be no worse than the goalkeeper of the first team."
Thomas opened his mouth in surprise, and then said with joy on his face: "Really? Then let’s continue! "
Thomas had a heartfelt trust in Wang Li. Ever since he got to know Wang Li, he felt that this black-haired boy had a strong sense of mystery all over him. His strange way of sleeping, Chinese Kung Fu, and artistic dribbling posture all made him feel an ancient mystery. He didn't understand why, but it didn't stop him from trusting this mystery.
After hearing that Thomas wanted to continue, Wang Li suddenly broke into a cold sweat and hurriedly said: "Forget it, I'm almost exhausted, let's just get here today. "
Thomas was still a little unfinished, but he also knew that Wang Li had been doing physical exercises at noon recently, and it was obviously impossible for him to have so much energy to continue practicing with him.
He put his arms on both sides, jumped vertically, and said: "Okay, let's go back, and you will continue to practice with me tomorrow. My dream is to become England's national team. By then, I will have money, a wife, and even a young woman, hehe...hehe!" "
Looking at Thomas, who had an innocent expression on his face but said such words, Wang Li wondered if it was a mistake to help him...
...
After the two returned to the dormitory and took a shower, Thomas planned to take Wang Li to have dinner together.
Usually, at noon, they eat nutritious meals provided by the club, and they have to make dinner by themselves. In the past few nights, Wang Li has made it at a fast food restaurant next to the club.
The two of them got dressed, packed their things a little, and got ready to go out.
At this time, Wang Li's cell phone rang. He took it out of his trouser pocket and looked at the display on it. It was Harrelson Clark.
‘That’s weird, why is Harrelson calling me at this time? ’ He was a little confused and pressed the answer button.
"Hi Alan, I'm Harrelson, where are you? "
"I'm in the dormitory, and I'm planning to go to dinner with Thomas. "
"That's great, Alan, come to this chipstix on the west side of the club. I'll treat you. Pete is here too. After dinner, we'll go to the Forest Bar together. By the way, I'll call Thomas. Harrelson said in one breath.
Wang Li was stunned, and then he remembered that before the game against Manchester United, Harrelson had said that if he could score, he would invite him to the bar to order anything. He said "hmm", smiled and said to the phone: "Okay, I'll be right back. "
For Wang Li, of course he would not miss out on being invited to dinner.
Practicing internal martial arts requires a lot of food to provide nutrition. This is what is often said in the martial arts world, "eat meat and drink alcohol". The salary of the youth team is only enough for his meals, so what he likes most now is to be treated by others.
And since he came to Wolverhampton, he has been training and has not gone out to play. Today's training is enough, and it is not bad to go out and play.
